target_customer: B2B go-to-market teams (sales and marketing) at software companies
problem: Sales teams lose track of former champions and buyers when they change jobs and rely on stale contact data. UserGems tracks job changes and surfaces high intent buyers, now with AI agents for outbound and ABM.

founders.name: Christian Kletzl
founders.background_notes: Austrian, living in Chicago when he recruited his twin brother; per TechCrunch 2021-10-26.

founders.name: Stephan Kletzl
founders.background_notes: Twin brother of Christian; per TechCrunch 2021-10-26.

technical_complexity.rationale: Matching job changes across large contact datasets and CRM integrations is standard data engineering with some hard parts around data freshness.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated relationship data and CRM integrations create some lock in, but contact data vendors could add job change alerts.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TechCrunch in 2021 named ZoomInfo and LinkedIn as the incumbent prospecting platforms; no source shows them copying or buying UserGems.

market_need_then: The 2014 batch idea (ShelfFlip) was a used goods marketplace; the eventual product addressed sales teams losing champions to job changes, which the founders noticed while building SmartHires in 2015.

branding.domain_note: Uses usergems.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.mascot_or_character: AI writing agent named Gem-E (per a review summary)
identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly gem puns; hosts a Humans of GTM community event per company news.

branding.brand_signature: Gem-E AI agent name and the Humans of GTM event series
branding.community_and_virality: Company news lists Humans of GTM events; no independent fan or merch evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable pun style name and an owned community event, but the sources are company pages and review sites, with no independent brand press.

pivots.from: ShelfFlip, a marketplace for used books and electronics
pivots.to: SmartHires, a referral network for startup talent
pivots.why: Dropped ShelfFlip during the YC batch, inspired by other YC pivots (TechCrunch 2021-10-26).
Other founders showed more interest in the tracking tool built inside SmartHires (TechCrunch 2021-10-26).

outcome_analysis: UserGems entered YC in Summer 2014 with an unrelated marketplace idea, pivoted twice, and found its fit by tracking buyer job changes. It raised a 2.4 million dollar seed and a 20 million dollar Series A led by Craft in 2021 and now sells an AI go to market platform with about 100 staff. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found.
